single.rationale: Corning shows impressive turnaround momentum with FY2025 revenue growing 19% and operating margins expanding to 14.6%, achieving Springboard plan targets a year early. The company's dominant positions in optical communications (38% of sales, benefiting from AI-driven data center demand) and display markets, combined with strong cash generation ($2.7B OCF) and reasonable valuation relative to improving fundamentals, warrant deeper analysis despite elevated P/E.

dropped.claim: Corning delivered exceptional cyclical recovery in FY2025 with revenue growing 19.1% to $15.6B and net income more than tripling to $1.6B from $506.0M, driven by surging demand for optical communications products (38% of sales) serving AI-driven hyperscale data centers and carrier networks, though profitability remains highly concentrated in two segments and exposed to significant customer concentration, supply chain, and IRS examination risks that could materially impact future results.

Revenue growth of 19.1% in FY2025 may significantly overstate underlying business momentum because it follows a severe trough year where revenue declined from $14.2B in FY2022 to $12.6B in FY2023, representing an 11% decline. The 3-year revenue CAGR of only 3.3% reveals that FY2025 revenue of $15.6B barely exceeds FY2022 levels, indicating the recent growth is primarily cyclical recovery rather than secular acceleration.
